results.title: The Repercussions of Silence and Its Violences
results.original_title: Le Ripercussoni del Silenzio e le Sue Violenze
results.overview: An unsuspecting man chooses not to intervene when he witnesses an act of harassment, believing that it is the victim's problem alone. He soon begins to struggle with his coscience.

results.title: The Only One
results.overview: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

results.title: Impure
results.overview: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

results.title: The Dark Gets In
results.overview: When a documentary team set out to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a young girl, events soon take an unexpected turn, leading the filmmakers down an increasingly dark and horrifying path.

results.title: Grayscale
results.overview: Paul, a drug dealer-turned-reseller, has lost his supply of sneakers. His boss, who lent him the money to buy the shoes, confronts him about Gabriel, Paul's business partner who has supposedly disappeared with the supply. The conflict between these three men will come to a boiling point: paranoia, obsession, and murder.

results.title: Riptides
results.overview: A daughter's diabolical plan to preserve her father's legacy is torpedoed by a demented boogie boarder on a self-help bender.

results.title: Baby Majeur
results.overview: Umi, a singer-songwriter, has just become a mother. In her urban flat, she tries to get the hang of life as a mum. But this is disrupted by chaos: noise from her upstairs neighbour, hustle and bustle, and unsolicited advice. Amid pumping, nappies and other people's expectations, Umi briefly loses herself. Slowly, she seeks the space to reconnect with her own feelings. With her ukulele, she begins turning her emotions into music and finds her own voice again.

results.title: Time Capsule
results.overview: Grief consumes Luiza since the loss of her father months ago. In her daily life, she battles memories of the tragedy and tries to move forward, despite an absence that seems to be everywhere. Then, an unexpected memory regarding the “treasure” her father left behind leads her to find comfort where she least expected it—and to view her own loss in a different light.

results.title: Too Tight to Move
results.overview: A young traveler tries out a brand-new, top of the line massage chair.

results.title: Lizzie Borden: The Hatchet House
results.overview: Troubled gothic teenager Ellie feels isolated, angry, and betrayed by her fractured family. Seeking connection and understanding, she turns to the legend of Lizzie Borden, the infamous axe murderer of Fall River.

results.title: No Hands: The Wild Ride of the Schwinn Bicycle Company
results.original_title: No Hands: The Wild Ride of the Schwinn Bicycle Company
results.overview: Founded in Chicago in 1895, Schwinn grew into an American icon, giving generations of kids their first taste of freedom on two wheels.  Narrated by Lance Armstrong, No Hands traces the company’s extraordinary rise, innovations and mysterious collapse while exploring its influence on childhood, BMX, mountain biking and American culture.  Through family members, cycling pioneers, collectors and industry leaders, the film reveals a story not simply about a bicycle company, but about memory, family, reinvention and what a first bike came to mean in American life.

results.title: Calidis
results.overview: An escaped witch performs an incantation. Created as part of Dillon Hammi’s DREAM SUICIDE series.

results.title: After Contact
results.original_title: Depois do Impacto: A História do Coritiba Crocodiles
results.overview: After a bus crash kills three players, the Coritiba Crocodiles, a Brazilian football team, returns for a new season, discovering that breaking through grief is a battle fought one yard at a time.

results.title: BAHANA
results.overview: A mute girl living with her abusive mother creates Alan, a mysterious companion who becomes her only escape. But as reality begins to unravel, Nada must confront what Alan truly represents.

results.title: Landing Nowhere
results.overview: Two astronauts stranded on a deserted planet must decide between completing their mission - repopulating a new world artificially. Or preserve the planet's untouched beauty & let humanity fade away...

results.title: Reteté
results.overview: The 1990s. A radiant, indomitable girl is medicated until she becomes the well-behaved child the church demands. To reclaim the daughter she once knew, her mother must confront her congregation, her family, and even God.

results.title: The First Flight
results.overview: A pidgeon seeking to learn to fly finds help from the most unexpected being possible.

results.title: The Hinterlands of Our Memories
results.overview: A road movie traveling from Rio de Janeiro to the "sertão" (backlands) of Bahia. With the help of three survivors, the film revisits a 1971 massacre that took place under the military dictatorship. The attack claimed the lives of Captain Carlos Lamarca—the regime's public enemy number one—and José Campos Barreto ("Zequinha"), a community leader and former organizer of one of the few workers' strikes following the military coup. After years of fear and oblivion, the towns where the tragedy occurred now honor both men.
